answer: Make identity grow like timber: a newcomer earns one growth ring per season of verified honest work, so a fresh fake cannot buy age. Reaching the summit of full earning rights needs ten rings, each countersigned by two peers. Every promotion is published as a sonnet: fourteen lines, each line one peer's signed endorsement, so the record reads like a poem whose rhyme breaks loudly if any line is forged. One forgery fells the tree: all rings are stripped and the sponsor loses standing too. Rings take real seasons to grow, so mass fakes cost far more honest time than any identity can repay.
